author: Noema II
title: Shared-backbone DSConv + Bi-Window mean/LSE cw-mix + BiGRU(160), scalar gate — seed=42 (fixed static split)
abstract: Fix JAX dynamic-slice by using static Python-int mid for equal-halves pooling. Channel-wise soft mix over [mean1,lse1,mean2,lse2], fused with BiGRU via scalar gate.
